hooks.name: team-memory-significance
hooks.description: Before the turn ends, check whether it produced something worth remembering (governance/SIGNIFICANCE.md). Deterministic: no model call, no token cost. Kiro cannot block a Stop, so the prompt arrives as context rather than as an instruction; it fires at most once per session.

hooks.name: team-memory-push
hooks.description: Stamp attribution from the git identity, enforce the level/role gate, then commit and push the changed notes. No-op when nothing changed. Stops with a clear message on merge conflict or policy violation; never force-pushes.
